evidence.name: Screen field: The height number
evidence.userNeed: Know what "The height number" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: The height number
sections.description: This is the number that pairs with your height mode. With Fixed mode, type pixels (0 to 1000, for example 320 for a tall hero); with Percent mode, type a share of the screen (0 to 100, for example 40). The box is ignored in Auto mode. For a scrollable section, this also sets the visible window the content scrolls inside.
